profile.headline: Software Engineer at Truss
profile.summary: Software Engineer passionate about web development, machine learning, and exploring AI opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: A forward thinking tech consulting company with contracts in government and the private sector. Truss transforms the way organizations design, build, and scale their software.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description:
Candidate experience consulting organization working with startups and tech companies. Improving company brands by improving the quality of their candidates' interview experiences. 

Build tech tools in Python to assist businesses in creating a seamless candidate experience and more inclusive technical interview process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work with a talented product team to build innovative employee feedback software. The programming languages I work with include: Ruby(Rails), Elixir, and Javascript (React).

positions.title: Freelance Data Strategist (Qualitative and Quantitative) and mHealth Designer
positions.description: I assist clients with their qualitative and quantitative data analysis needs. My speciality is focus group research: from designing interview questions that are appropriate for the subject population, training staff in moderating focus groups, to preparing qualitative analysis reports. As a researcher, my skills are highly sought after within the tech industry and I work with clients to conduct user-experience research in order to develop products that meet business needs and user interests, with the goal of saving businesses money in beta testing.

positions.title: Research Coordinator & Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Held overall responsibility for shepherding multiple research projects from concept development, planning, execution to evaluation. 
•	Developed tools to track project status against timeline and budget, and routinely reported progress to senior leadership
•	Supervised team of junior-level assistants 
•	Leveraged resources within the department in cost-effective management, reducing project costs by 15% (without compromising study objectives)
•	Trained assistants in focus group interviewing techniques and qualitative data analysis
•	Successfully executed projects designed for diverse study populations, which developed partnerships in previously-hard to reach communities
•	Analyzed quantitative project data using Stata software and interpreted findings for non-scientific audiences 
•	Developed user-friendly nutrition information guides for print and video

company.name: The Gerald J. and Dorothy R. Friedman School of Nutrition Science and Policy at Tufts University

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Selected as a teaching assistant due to extensive research experience and app development experience using behavioral change theory to design new technologies 
• Taught students to design mobile phone based app interventions using behavior change theories and principles.
• Utilized graphic interphases to facilitate student learning of new course materials.

company.name: Friedman School of Nutrition Science and Policy at Tufts University

positions.title: Lead Advisor
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of a nutrition app written in Ruby on Rails. 
• The Nutrition Algorithm startup company that generates personalized food shopping recommendations based on user budget, taste preferences, and nutritional requirements. Researched user population using complex analysis of grocery store shopping trends in the US and competed in start-up competitions.
• Designed lean business plan and pitched to angel investors

positions.title: Research Coordinator
positions.description:
• Managed qualitative research portion of study including Key Informant Interviews from conception to execution. One of a team of three research coordinators to conduct quantitative research for this clinical trial.
•  Developed partnerships with community leaders, resulting in the successful recruitment of 100% of our target study population (n=200) within a one year deadline.
•. Multilingual skills served as an asset in building partnerships with multicultural community organizations that served the study population.
•. Responsible for interviewing and screening phlebotomists for the study.
•  Analyzed qualitative data using NVivo and authored a paper.

company.name: USDA Jean Mayer Human Nutrition Research Center on Aging

positions.title: Resident Director
positions.description:
•	Oversaw and managed two residential facilities and 342 residents
•	Supervised junior staff, developed staff performance reviews and interviewed potential candidates 
•	Trained in Conflict Resolution and guided staff in resolving residential disputes and problem solving.

projects.description: I love showcasing all of the work I have been doing as a designer and programmer. Check out my work and ongoing projects. Reach out for coffee if you'd love to hear more in person.
